name: dsh-token-frugal
description: Cut the input-token cost of long Harness sessions: structure-aware tool-output compression, per-agent tool-catalogue visibility, a composer panel that turns each saving on or off, and a per-workspace session memory that is matched before the transcript is re-read.

meta.title: Token Frugal
meta.description: Compresses tool output at the source, trims the tool catalogue, and keeps a per-workspace session memory that recall matches before the transcript is re-read. Every saving has a switch under the composer; a measurement script reports the token and cache-hit-rate effect.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/compress.js && node --check lib/estimate.js && node --check lib/defaults.js && node --check lib/modes.js && node --check lib/memo.js && node --check lib/recall.js && node --check tools/measure-tokens.mjs && node --check test/load-check.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run load-check
